text: I had you come ’cause I wanted to hear what\nyou thought.[VAR 0114(000B)]
So, that geoglyph...\nWhat do you think of it?[VAR 0114(000B)]
Right perceptive of you.\c\nEspecially since the portion depicting the black\nstorm has mostly disappeared.[VAR 0114(000B)]

Seems likely...
It certainly looks like a gigantic Pokémon.\c
I suppose people three thousand years ago
could’ve just imagined this, but it looks too
similar to Dynamax. It can’t just be coincidence.[VAR 0114(000B)]

A long time ago...a great black storm covered
the Galar region. Giant Pokémon ran rampant...\c
But what was that black storm they called
“the Darkest Day”?
What connection does it have to Dynamax?[VAR 0114(000B)]
Guess I’m the lucky lady who’ll be looking\ninto that... Gran sure gives me a lot to do.[VAR 0114(000B)]
Thanks for your thoughts on the matter!\nAs thanks, I’ll give you a League Card.[VAR 0114(000B)]

Milo’s a Grass-type Gym Leader. Things will go
well for you if you use Fire-, Flying-, or
Bug-type moves.\c
Take these, too! It’d be pretty bad if your
Pokémon weren’t in fighting form![VAR 0114(000B)]
Go on, then! Get yourself to Turffield Stadium\nand battle yourself silly![VAR 0114(000B)]
